instruction: Write a JavaScript debounce(fn, wait) utility that delays invocation until calls stop for wait ms, preserving the last arguments.
Write a JavaScript throttle(fn, limit) utility that guarantees at most one call per limit ms, firing a trailing call with the latest args.
Write a JavaScript memoize(fn) utility that caches results keyed by the first argument only, with a cache.size accessor.
Write a JavaScript pub/sub class with subscribe(topic, handler) returning an unsubscribe function, and publish(topic, data).
Write a JavaScript createSingleton(getter) helper that returns the same instance from getter on every call.
Write a JavaScript factory function makeAnimal(type, name) that returns specialized objects (dog/cat) sharing a speak interface, without classes.
Write a JavaScript strategy pattern: a payment function that accepts a strategy object with creditCard, paypal or crypto methods and dispatches by name.
Write the JavaScript module pattern using an IIFE to expose only selected functions from private internals.
Write a JavaScript proxy-based validator: createValidator(schema) returns a Proxy that throws on unknown keys or wrong value types on assignment.
Write JavaScript immutable update helpers: setIn(obj, path, value) returning a new object with one nested value replaced without mutation.
Write JavaScript pipe(...fns) and compose(...fns) utility functions for unary functions, with examples.
Write a JavaScript curryN(fn, arity) that curries a function of arbitrary arity.
Write a JavaScript deepClone(value) utility handling objects, arrays, Dates and Maps.
Write a JavaScript class-based EventEmitter with once(event, fn) that automatically unsubscribes after the first emit.
Write a JavaScript finite state machine createMachine(definition) supporting send(event) with transitions, initial state and a changed listener.
Write a JavaScript repository pattern: createRepository(items) returning getAll, getById, add, remove methods over an in-memory array with generated ids.
Write a JavaScript builder class QueryBuilder that chains where, orderBy and limit and produces a SQL-like string.
Write a JavaScript adapter pattern: an OldPrinter class with print(text) and a ModernDoc interface expecting printDoc(page); write an adapter and use it.
Write a JavaScript middleware pipeline: runMiddleware(context, middlewares) that awaits each middleware in order, each getting a next() function.
Write JavaScript code implementing a simple cache with TTL: createTtlCache(ttlMs) with set, get (returning undefined when expired) and clear.
